blocks.text: OPM stars Kyla and Erik Santos will headline their first major concert together, “When Love Sings,” scheduled for Feb. 19, 2027. This was announced by Cornerstone Entertainment via its social media pages on Monday, Oct. 26. The concert will be held at the Newport Performing Arts Theater, with John Prats as the director and Homer Flores as the musical director. Ticket sales will begin on Nov. 13.
